decision_basis: IL-36alpha engages IL1RL2 and ligand-dependent recruitment of IL1RAP is supported by quantitative receptor-binding and pathway studies.
IL-36beta is an agonist for the IL1RL2/IL1RAP pathway, with exact ligand-receptor binding and processed-ligand receptor-complex evidence retained in the source packet.
IL-36gamma is an agonist for the IL1RL2/IL1RAP pathway, with exact ligand-receptor binding and receptor-complex recruitment evidence retained in the source packet.
Activin A binds ACVR2B, recruits ACVR1B/ALK4, and activates the canonical SMAD2/3 branch in receptor and functional studies.
